description:
Confirm whether browser-automation-studio exposes the screenshot capture API/CLI surface required by bas-grounded-mockup-integration. The integration item assumes BAS has commands to (a) load a URL or scenario UI, (b) capture a viewport or element screenshot, (c) return a path/URL/base64 for downstream image-generation reference input.

Search BAS public CLI, public API, and any documented MCP/SDK surfaces. If the surface exists, document the call signatures. If not, identify the gap and either (1) file a backlog item against BAS to add the surface, or (2) propose an alternative grounding mechanism.

Output: research conclusion under scenarios/swarm-manager/research/bas-screenshot-api-audit/conclusion.md with: existing surface inventory, gap list (if any), and clear go/no-go for bas-grounded-mockup-integration. Update orchestration-summary.md.

Why now: Hidden blocker — bas-grounded-mockup-integration depends on BAS having capabilities that haven't been verified. Cheaper to audit now than during execute. Surfaced during 2026-04-25 vision-walk audit. Note: this also intersects with the broader BAS-readiness initiative discussion (#22 plus competitive-intel substrate work) — findings here may inform BAS-readiness scope.
name: bas-screenshot-api-audit
title: Audit BAS screenshot capture API/CLI surface for grounding flow
